commitments.detail: Obtain written university consent or license for C1 subject matter before C1 may be added back to the claim set.
C2 and C4 are removed from the application due to lack of enabling support across stated operating ranges. Narrower supported claims may remain.
C3 is omitted as it is not aligned with the immediate commercial objective; C5 must be included as the priority commercial claim.
Filing package must be updated to include the EP filing route alongside the U.S. application to preserve European rights for the German market.

Filing is not authorized until ownership clearance for C1 is resolved, the claim set is finalized as C5 (with C1 conditionally reinstatable upon university consent), and the EP filing route is incorporated into the package.
